description_html:
This two bedroom flat (Type 21) in on the 5th floor of Andrewes House with original Brooke Marine kitchen and bathroom. It overlooks the Barbican lake and is close to Moorgate station and the Arts Centre. Available unfurnished.

This 5th floor two-bedroom flat (Type 21) has a bright south facing reception room with ceiling to floor glass and a sliding door leading onto a private balcony. There is an aspect towards St Giles of Cripplegate and the spectacular London Wall Place development. The kitchen is the original Brooke Marine and the bathroom and separate WC also have original fittings. A spacious corridor / hall, with room for cupboards or a desk, leads up to the two north facing double bedrooms overlooking the Barbican Lake. Both bedrooms have large ceiling to floor windows allowing lots of natural light and also have ceiling to floor original fitted wardrobes offering ample storage space. The larger of the two bedrooms has a door leading out onto the open balcony/fire escape. Background underfloor heating throughout is included in the rent.

This flat is a short walk from the shopping amenities and restaurants around Moorgate, including a large Marks and Spencer, and Whitecross Street, where there is a Waitrose. The closest station is Moorgate (National Rail, Northern line, Circle, Hammersmith and City and Metropolitan line). To the south lies Cheapside, One New Change shopping centre and St Paul's.

Residents facilities and services: full use of the private Barbican gardens; storage lockers and parking are available by separate arrangement; collection of rubbish and recycling from your door; cycle parking; 24 hour porterage; tennis courts (small fee applies); proximity of the world renowned Barbican Arts Centre with its concert hall, cinema screens, theatre, galleries, library, shops, bars and restaurants.

Managed by the City of London Corporation, the Barbican Estate is the finest achievement of the architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon. It was Grade II listed in 2001 in recognition of its extraordinary contribution to London's urban landscape.

Underfloor heating included in rent
